questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,

'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A × B' means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

'A ÷ B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is K related to N if ‘K × L ÷ M + N – O’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1887e263a0be106c3fc3bef05d4c58742c6a15e36b93bc74e9b8034e1f5d249.png] 

 
 

 A is

 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 of B
 
 

Given Expression: K × L ÷ M + N – O

K × L: K is the wife of L. (K is female, L is male)

L ÷ M: L is the father of M. (L is male)

M + N: M is the mother of N. (M is female)

N – O: N is the brother of O. (N is male)

Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac8409d467efb081eb50f62690f95320618aba019ac198f0837257e878f3fbe5.png] 

The gender of O is not specified.

K is the mother of M, and M is the mother of N.

Therefore, K is the **mother's mother** of N, also known as the maternal grandmother.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

H I _ L _ H _ K _ M H _ _ L M H I K _ _
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Series: H I _ L _ H _ K _ M H _ _ L M H I K _ _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

1) MKILIKLM → H I __**M**__ L __**K**__ / H __**I**__ K __**L**__ M / H __**I**__ __**K**__ L M / H I K __**L**__ __**M**__

2) MKLIIKML → H I __**M**__ L __**K**__ / H __**L**__ K __**I**__ M / H __**I**__ __**I**__ L M / H I K __**M**__ __**L**__

3) KMLIIKML → H I __**K**__ L __**M**__ / H __**L**__ K __**I**__ M / H __**I**__ __**I**__ L M / H I K __**M**__ __**L**__

**4) KMILIKLM** → H I __**K**__ L __**M**__ / H __**I**__ K __**L**__ M / H __**I**__ __**K**__ L M / H I K __**L**__ __**M**__

The full sequence is (HIKLM) (HIKLM) (HIKLM) (HIKLM).

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

No sand is a flower.

(II): Some sand are trees.

questions.question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters U, V, W, X, Y and Z. Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having Y?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c8d515aaa497e943d702975504473e0addb2d4899741a6274e2363286999759.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee4f185ea3e3990cd21ce5624d2d40094b82b3ddfebdfae5b6b6ddec72984115.png] 

Logic: If two dice have one face in common. Then the remaining surfaces are opposite to each other.

Opposite pairs

X ⇔ V

W ⇔ U

Z ⇔ Y

Thus, Z is opposite to face Y.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
